title: hahnia arbutifolia
intro: Hahnia arbutifolia, commonly known as the Indian alder, is a plant species native to the Indian subcontinent and parts of Southeast Asia. The Indian alder is a deciduous shrub or small tree with numerous health benefits, including the treatment of fever, diarrhea, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Hahnia arbutifolia include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its effectiveness in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
